description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vampire Charmseeker and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Vampire Charmseeker and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
